attempt: first actual OS attempt, regardless of outcome
intervention: Change only history_md session membership: full original history versus current episode and its ancestors. Preserve all lessons, accepted skills, current task, runtime evidence, images, system prompt and output ceiling exactly.
purpose: Test whether a real legal input-scope choice changes work and verdict; no learned router, no Laya control, no online environment intervention
quality_limits: Original inputs contain native scoring fields in both variants. Verdict agreement and native-label agreement are descriptive only, not an independent visual-quality test. No downstream retry or robot savings claim from this replay.
accounting: Record every actual request/response, HTTP latency, prompt/output tokens, projection time, preparation/loading/residency. Counterbalance pair order. All attempts count; incomplete pairs do not become cost reductions.
stop: Abort on incomplete source evidence, changed retained fields, invalid response or resource conflict. Do not replace an unfavorable case or expand roster after viewing outcomes.
